lessons.advice: When supporting pandas nullable label dtypes, inspect both target-type inference and label extraction. Keep missing-value handling separate from the demonstrated non-missing binary-label cases.

assumptions.statement: unique_labels raises ValueError when the set of inferred target types still has more than one member after the binary/multiclass normalization.

scope.inputs: At least one y argument; type_of_target calls succeed; normalized type set has cardinality greater than one

assumptions.statement: After the helper edit, type_of_target returns "binary" for the demonstrated Int64 Series containing only zeros and ones with no missing values.

scope.env: pandas available in the recorded task environment
